### [`copy_source_bitmap_offsets`](../../../../src/tools/copy_35de.asm#L6) `$35DE-$35E0`

### [`copy_source_colour_bases`](../../../../src/tools/copy_35de.asm#L9) `$35E1`

*data*

2 bytes for each copy_source (0 and 2): the high byte of the source screen colours ($d0, $d8), then the distance to the source colour RAM ($04).
